notes: Seed page (atascosacounty.texas.gov/page/atascosa.Elections) returns 404; the domain redirects to co.atascosa.tx.us, whose Elections Administration page lists results under 'Past Elections'. No Clarity site (elections.json 404). For every target election the unofficial files are scanned Electionware 'Summary Results Report' county totals ('Unofficial Results - Election Day' and '- Early Voting'); precinct numbers appear only in official files (e.g. March 3, 2026 'Official Results - Precinct Detail'). The 2024 general files were re-uploaded in January 2026 (wp-content/uploads/2026/01), so they carry no election-night upload time. Primary and runoff files have printed run times and server upload times on election night. Dashes in link titles replaced with hyphens.
tag_rationale: All three elections are LATER (county totals only on election night; precinct detail only in official reports), so the tag is COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS; confidence med because the primary and runoff were settled by check 2 with printed and upload times on election night.
